initialization_notes.sparse: Random valid connected sparse tree, with neutral occupied atoms.
initialization_notes.dense: Same atom probabilities as the seed's sparse start; independently dense random bond probabilities.
initialization_notes.fragmented: Same sparse start with four tree bonds deleted.

notes: Every condition runs the full 500-update budget; chemical failure is an outcome.
A shared control is one seed replicate even if referenced by several comparisons.
Cooling uses the same intended graph for native and teacher inputs.
The simple_soft_valence comparison is an explicit new baseline, not a claim of reproducing a historical custom chemistry objective.
This is a staged ablation design, not the full Cartesian product of every setting.
